[color=#00e1c8]HOW TO PLAY[/color]
The penalty taker must score a goal, while the goalkeeper must stop the shot at all costs.

[color=#00e1c8]CONTROLS[/color]
* As the penalty taker, press [color=#ffac00]\[Space][/color] to shoot.
* As the goalkeeper, press [color=#ffac00]\[Left][/color] and [color=#ffac00]\[Right][/color] to choose
   where to dive.

[color=#00e1c8]GAME MODES[/color]
* Press [color=#ffac00]\[1][/color] to play as the penalty taker against the CPU.
* Press [color=#ffac00]\[2][/color] to play as the goalkeeper against the CPU.
* Press [color=#ffac00]\[3][/color] to play in 2-Player mode.
* Press [color=#ffac00]\[4][/color] to watch the CPU play.
